beats.config_opened: [CONFIG MENU] play mode / evolution preference / gates — picking one applies it and stays on this page; pick "back" to return to the stage menu. Note: switching play mode leaves this page (the driver changed, so the sub-page context is stale). Evolution pre-registration does not use the menu: write settings with `config.set review.evolution.artifact|summary|candidates|classes=<value>`; after verify passes the settlement.evolution menu builds the payload and validates it in one place.
beats.config_keys: play.mode / goal.authorization / executor.<rN>.<analysis|plan|development> / evolution.mode / evolution.max_per_run / gates.require_all_green / review.evolution.artifact / review.evolution.summary / review.evolution.candidates / review.evolution.classes
beats.goal_auth_registered: [GOAL AUTH REGISTERED] {{auth}} (self-declared, not identity proof; the closing check applies only to runs that entered goal at runtime)
beats.goal_auth_pending: [GOAL AUTH PENDING] entered goal mode without goal.authorization; register config.set goal.authorization=<note> before review.note
beats.goal_auth_cleared: [GOAL AUTH CLEARED] a runtime goal run must register it again before closing.
beats.goal_auth_bad: goal authorization must be a single line (non-empty after trim, <= 200 chars, no newline).
beats.goal_auth_required: this run entered goal at runtime: register the run-level authorization before closing with `config.set goal.authorization=<authorization note>` (self-declared; a static goal preset in data/config.json is out of scope).
beats.config_goal_auth: goal authorization: {{auth}} (self-declared, only checked when a runtime goal run closes)
beats.config_goal_auth_none: goal authorization: not registered (only runs that entered goal at runtime need it; a static default is not checked)
beats.executor_unknown_req: executor registration points at a missing requirement: `{{id}}`.
beats.executor_bad_id: an executor id must be non-empty after trim, <= 64 chars, with no whitespace and no `|`.
beats.executor_reason_required: changing the executor requires a reason: `config.set executor.{{id}}.{{stage}}=<new_id>|<reason>` (previous executor {{prev}}; cross-stage handoff needs one too).
beats.tool_replayed: [REPLAY:TOOL] call `{{call_id}}` with external_id `{{ext}}` was already applied — idempotent return, not executed twice.
beats.tool_after_done: the run has reached its ending: no tool call can be requested or settled any more.
beats.tool_not_allowed: tool `{{tool_id}}` is not in data/config.json `allowedTools` (allowed: {{allowed}}) — refused before anything was stored.
beats.tool_usage: tool.call <tool_id>[|<k=v;...>][|<call_id>] — the tool id must be listed in allowedTools; arguments are `k=v` pairs separated by `;`
beats.tool_result_usage: tool.result <call_id>|<tool_id>|<ok|err>|<code>|<output>[|<external_id>] (5 or 6 segments; a vertical bar may not appear inside the output)
beats.tool_bad_tool_id: tool id `{{tool_id}}` must look like `<namespace>.<name>`: lowercase letters/digits/underscore/hyphen in both segments, at most 64 bytes.
beats.tool_bad_call_id: call id `{{call_id}}` is not usable: lowercase letters/digits/hyphen/underscore, 1..{{max}} chars, and not one of count / pending / last / notified.
beats.tool_call_dup: call id `{{call_id}}` already exists ({{status}}); use a fresh id, or resend the same external_id to replay.
beats.tool_capacity: no free tool slot ({{cap}} calls already allocated); settle the pending calls first.
beats.tool_unknown_call: no tool call `{{call_id}}` exists in this run.
beats.tool_result_mismatch: call `{{call_id}}` does not accept this result: expected {{expected}}, got {{got}}.
beats.tool_bad_code: code `{{code}}` must be an integer (use `-1` when the tool never ran).
beats.vfs_usage: usage: `vfs.write` takes `artifacts/<name>.md|<content>` (path must be artifacts/*.md, content 1..{{max}} bytes)
beats.vfs_path_rejected: [VFS PATH REFUSED] {{path}}: only artifacts/<name>.md is writable (no `..`, no whitespace, at most {{max}} bytes)
beats.vfs_ledger_only: [VFS LEDGER ONLY] {{path}} ({{bytes}} B): this host exposes no `ygg.fs`, so nothing reached the disk - the artifact ledger records the Mod-side assertion only
beats.subagent_delta: Resume {{id}} (rev {{rev}}) for stage `{{stage}}` in worktree `{{worktree}}`; write `{{artifact}}` and submit.
beats.reactive_malformed: [PROBE MALFORMED] {{call_id}} ({{tool_id}}): the output is not a `k=v;...` map - nothing was applied
beats.artifact_path_rejected: [ARTIFACT PATH REFUSED] {{path}}: the ledger only accepts artifacts/<name>.md (no `..`, no whitespace, at most {{max}} bytes) | nothing was recorded
beats.executor_bad_actor: an actor id must be non-empty after trim, <= 64 chars, with no whitespace and no quote/backslash (the host injects `actor=`; self-carried segments are rejected).
beats.executor_bad_actor_session: an actor_session id must be non-empty after trim, <= 128 chars, with no whitespace and no quote/backslash (the host injects `actor_session=`; self-carried segments are rejected).
